scope: Implement optional synchronous A32/T32 scalar VFP trapping profile rather than advertising FPTrap=1 with RES0 enables; precise whole-instruction flag accumulation and destination rollback, guest/system/user delivery and complete private-state continuation across supported standalone execution planes. Cover selected mixed-width enable forwarding/A64 delivery and active-trap native fallback; do not claim physical optional-trap/native execution validation. Full four original findings remain open.

assumptions.assumption: Synchronous whole-instruction accumulation reports enabled trapped causes, preserves unenabled cumulative status and rolls back destinations.
assumptions.basis: Retained FPProcessException/FPRoundBase and DDI0406C.d/DDI0487B.a status definitions; TFV and exact/flush underflow corrections have observed regressions.
assumptions.dependent_result: Truthful optional FPTrap=1 view and precise destination rollback.
assumptions.stress_test: Six exception causes,combined flags,prior sticky flags and enables,aliasing,half/single/double and short vectors.
assumptions.falsification_probe: Trap updates a destination or an already-sticky exception fails to trap.

assumptions.assumption: VFP memory/system/bit transfers do not process IEEE operands and must bypass the arithmetic transaction.
assumptions.basis: Existing VFP instruction families and per-handler dataflow; FP access checks precede effects.
assumptions.dependent_result: No MMIO duplication,partial-memory rollback or system-register control masking.
assumptions.stress_test: Loads/stores/system-register reads/writes,failed conditions,access/capability priority and unchanged nontrapping default.
assumptions.falsification_probe: An excluded transfer changes its existing side effects under the new profile.

assumptions.assumption: A32 synchronous traps enter Undefined with FPEXC status; normal exceptions targeting A64 use EC0x28 and TFV/status.
assumptions.dependent_result: Local/Hyp/guest signal routing and zero-retirement boundary.
assumptions.stress_test: ARM/Thumb/local/Hyp/TGE and A64 EL1/EL2/EL3 delivery,zero retirement, Linux event mapping and actual1/2/4 prepared-context pre/post files; existing signal-frame masks audited for enables. No new exhaustive signal-frame/optional-profile hardware oracle.
assumptions.falsification_probe: Fault PC/IT or retired-instruction count advances, or enabled-cause status is lost.

assumptions.assumption: Trusted mixed-width MVFR metadata can select trapping; forward enables, support interpreted A64 delivery and guard cached/native entry while enables are active.
assumptions.basis: Current sysregs.aarch32_fp_ids reads trusted overrides; shared state drops0x9f00 and generic A64 mask excludes them.
assumptions.dependent_result: No false A64/native optional-trap execution claim; implemented standalone profile stays explicit.
assumptions.stress_test: ID aliases,existing mixed-width tests and native eligibility controls.
assumptions.falsification_probe: A supported mixed/native entry advertises or executes the new trapping profile without its delivery contract.

assumptions.assumption: TFV ignores guest writes and reads one when trapping is supported and short-vector controls are RAZ; UFE traps exact tiny results,while output flushes only accrue UFC.
assumptions.dependent_result: Correct control masks,typed A64 underflow capture and shared half rounding.
assumptions.stress_test: 16 ARM/Thumb TFV write cases,A64 mapped-register/EL partitions,half/single/double FZ/FZ16 partitions,conversion and exact SVE scaling.

assumptions.assumption: The full-run ptrace disconnect failure is independent of FP semantics and reproduced by concurrent host-fork test descriptor retention.
assumptions.basis: Unchanged ptrace make_call path enters syscalls directly; minimal5-test and two-test fork pair repros; isolated testcase passes.
assumptions.dependent_result: Keep full root gate failure explicit and handle test isolation as a separate semantic group.
assumptions.stress_test: 30 pairwise repeats: shared-words and pidfd fork peers each reproduce; no FP instruction is executed in the failing testcase.
assumptions.falsification_probe: Failure persists after isolation without a concurrent host-fork peer.

change_surface.decode: Existing direct allocation and capability/access checks remain before computation; reserved FPTrap fields fail closed.
change_surface.direct_execute: A32/T32 transaction and A64 typed status collection,all six causes and precise rollback.
change_surface.cpu_state: FPSCR enables,FPEXC/FPEXC32 status/RO rules,private FPSID0x41; no new serialized register field.
change_surface.memory_mmu: Storage transfers bypass arithmetic collection; faulting VLDM preserves partial completion and exact read count.
change_surface.smir_ir_lift: No IR/schema or A32 FP lifting added; existing A32 FP lifter rejection remains. Shared half arithmetic uses the existing controlled evaluator.
change_surface.smir_interpreter_optimizer_lowering: Arithmetic evaluators are reused; native compilation/cache entry rejects active selected trapping. Full owning A64 SMIR/ARM-Thumb JIT targets run.
change_surface.backend_machine: Standalone emulator,S3C and S5L delivery and zero retirement; complete S3C producer file continuation.
change_surface.user_api: A32 FP exit,Linux arm64/compat SIGFPE mapping and existing C exception record; C ABI unchanged.
change_surface.oracle: LLVM bytes and primary register/operation rules; existing default arithmetic/native tests run. No new physical optional-trap oracle.
